message: Sire, an armistice with Britain buys quiet on that front while France vs Austria + Britain + Russia continues elsewhere; it does not end the war, but it does end the bleeding.

diplomatic_dialogue.talleyrand_text: Sire, regarding the Armistice proposal to Britain, I have prepared terms appropriate to the current military situation.

terms.talleyrand_commentary: Britain values its continental footholds, but they are beyond our gift at present. We must work with what we have.

commitment_conflicts.display: Making peace with Britain while allied with Spain (who is still at war with Britain) creates a diplomatic contradiction.
Britain sits outside your bloc. Peace normalizes relations with a nation resisting your European influence.

display_lines: A 5-turn ceasefire: fighting stops and the war score freezes. No territory or gold changes hands at its end.
When it expires: peace if relations have healed to -60 or better — otherwise the war resumes.
Relations stand at -90 — unless they heal to -60 or better, the war resumes when the truce expires.

warnings.text: Britain's court sees the French-led alignment consolidating across Europe and will resist a cross-bloc agreement. Spain is the decisive non-france slice of the bloc; letting the alliance lapse would ease Europe's pressure.
